entry.title: Week 2 : Use Joule Chat to create ABAP RAP Application and explore the Explain feature
entry.content:
Last week we had completed the system set up and also created a package with your community ID. We had also gone through the help document on SAP Joule for Developers, ABAP AI Capabilities.

Now let us dive into the world of ABAP AI by creating an application where Joule will guide you during each step.

Quick Links

Please use this separate thread to ask your questions and discuss issues. 

Task 1: Create a ABAP RAP application using 'OData UI Service from Scratch’ wizard

It can be any application of your choice preferably non enterprise related to keep the challenge simple and more interesting. One field should be an amount field and another one a date field so that we can leverage J4D(Joule for Developers) to add some logic in the subsequent weeks. You should have 3 more fields which will be used to try out some of the J4D features.

Note: It is recommended to create all the fields while creating the app itself to avoid any manual coding later.

Example:- You can create a book store application consisting of fields ID, Title, Author, Price, Published Date, Stock, Discounted Price, BookAge. Here the last 3 fields can be used to try out the Joule for Developers (J4D) features. You are free to choose any dataset and logic combinations.

  1. Right click on the package ZAC_<your community ID> created and select ‘Generate ABAP Repository Objects’Generate ABAP Repository Objects’
  2. In the below popup that appears choose ‘Odata UI Service from Scratch’ and click on ‘Next’ two times.Odata UI Service from Scratch
  3. Click ‘Next’ again.Click Next
  4. In the next screen make sure you get the Joule Help to the right of Wizard popup. Here in the section ‘Ask Joule to update the fields’ can provide your prompts to create the application you like by specifying the fields and other details. Hit enter. Note: It is better to create all objects ending with your <community ID> to avoid any naming conflicts. Try to specify this in the prompt.Joule option in WizardNote: Make sure to select the option -  ‘Transactional with Draft’ highlighted in the above screenshot is selected to enable ‘Create’ option in the application getting created. For single entity sometimes it is set as ‘Without Draft’.
  5. Joule will now propose the Entity and Fields based on your prompt. Please note that we still should verify whether the suggestions are accurate for our requirements. Here you can notice that sometimes Joule suggests to change the Service Configuration to ‘Transactional Without Draft’, we can handle this in next step.Joule Field Proposal
  6. Once you are satisfied click on ‘Accept’ and you can see that the ‘Artifact Suffix’ if specified and the ‘Project Name’ gets added as shown in the below screenshot.           Here remember to change the Service Configuration to ‘Transactional with Draft’ and click ‘Next’.Joule Accept Proposal
  7. Joule lists the artifacts that will be created. Verify them again and click on ‘Next’ and then ‘Finish’ on the next screen. 
  8. Refresh the package and check all the artifacts have been created. Publish the Service Binding and preview the application.
  9. The application will open and should have a ‘Create’ button. Here you can either create a data generator class and add some simple logic to fill data / Use the ‘Create’ option in the app to create some sample records. ( Please create 4-5 entries in any case ). You can also adjust the metadata if you like.Application Created

For more information: https://help.sap.com/docs/abap-cloud/abap-development-tools-user-guide/use-odata-ui-service-from-scratch-wizard?locale=en-US

Task 2: Add a simple logic in the CDS data definition

  1. Add some simple logic in the CDS data definition for example to provide 2% discount on actual Price and fill another field say ‘DiscountedPrice’ with the discounted value for all records in the database.

    Note: The logic and examples are mentioned just for your reference and to make the purpose of the challenge easy to understand. Please feel free to use your own logic and dataset.

  2. Now that one of the fields was enhanced, you may need to recreate the draft table ending with _D### before launching the application again. If you do not face any issue you can skip this step.

    To do that, go to the Project Explorer and open the behavior definition click on the icon as shown on the picture to follow the quick fix. Save and activate the draft table.

    Recreate Draft Table

Task 3: Use Joule->Explain capability to understand code

Use ‘Explain’ capability of Joule to get detailed explanation of the code added.

Hint: Please add few lines of code like a simple CASE statement in CDS data definition to test Explain feature.

You may also watch this video to know more about how to use Joule->Explain feature.

We will be back next week with another feature of Joule AI Capability. Stay Tuned!!

entry.title: Week 3 : Use RAP Business Logic Prediction to Implement Validation
entry.content:
Last week we had created a RAP Application and added some entries in it. We also explored how to use Joule's 'Explain' feature to understand a simple code added in the CDS Data Definition. 

This week let us go one step further and explore another very interesting feature of Joule's ABAP AI capability -  The RAP Business Logic Prediction.

Quick Links

Please use this separate thread to ask your questions and discuss issues. 

Sample Scenario

Here let us think about any simple scenario like changing a field to ‘Mandatory’ and then create a new entry without filling value for this field. Empty values should not be accepted for the mandatory field and we can use the ‘validation’ keyword to check if its kept empty. Here use Joule’s ‘RAP Predict Business Logic’ capability to suggest the code to raise an error message in the implementation method of the validation function. Let’s see the steps in detail.

Task1: Create a validation and implement the corresponding method.

  1. Create a validation in the BDEF of the CDS view. Open your behavior definition and specify one of the fields as mandatory.Define Mandatory Field
  2. Define the Validation in same BDEF of the CDS view.Validation Defenition
  3. In order to have draft instances being checked by validations before they become active, they have to be specified for the draft determine action prepare in the behavior definition. Replace the code line draft determine action Prepare; in your BDEF with the following code snippet as shown on the screenshot below.Prepare Action
  4. Save and activate the changes.
  5. Now you can notice a small icon to the left of the validation definition. Click on it to create the implementation method for adding validation logic in the local handler class of the behavior pool of your entity. Save and activate the changes. Hint: You can right click on the new method name and choose Quick Fix as well.Implement ValidationFor additional information on Validations and its syntax and use you can refer the BDEF ‘/DMO/R_Travel_D’. Alternatively you can also refer https://github.com/SAP-samples/abap-platform-rap100/tree/main/exercises/ex05

Task2: Enhance validation with RAP Predict Business Logic

Use Joule's RAP Predict Business Logic to add the logic to check whether the mandatory field created in Task 1 is filled while creating a new entry. If it is left empty throw an error message.

Note:- The logic and examples are mentioned just for your reference and to make the purpose of the challenge easy to understand. Please feel free to use your own logic and dataset.

To know how to use RAP Predict Business Logic follow this tutorial. Hint: You can right click on the new method name and choose Quick Fix as well.

Good luck and wait for the last challenge next week. Until then Stay Jouled !!!

entry.title: Week 4 : Use Joule Predictive Code Completion to Implement Determination
entry.content:
Congratulations to everyone who came along with us till the 4th week of the ABAP Developer Challenge. So far we have seen :

  • How to create a OData UI Service from Scratch using Joule Chat
  • How to use Joule - Explain feature to understand a block of code.
  • How to use Joule - RAP Predict Business Logic to create logic for specific tasks.

Let us wrap up with another interesting feature of Joule's ABAP AI Capability - The Joule Predictive Code Completion.

Quick Links

Please use this separate thread to ask your questions and discuss issues. 

Sample Scenario

We had asked you to create a field of type 'Date' during the RAP application creation.

Now let us use Determination function to calculate the number of years since the value in Date field. You can implement it while creating a new record using the app.

Task1: Create a determination and implement the corresponding method.

  1. Define a determination in the BDEF of the CDS view.Define Determination
  2. Now you can notice a small icon to the left of the determination definition. Click on it to create the implementation method for adding determination logic in the local handler class of the behavior pool of your entity. Save and activate the changes.Implement DeterminationFor additional information on Determinations and its syntax and use you can refer the BDEF ‘/DMO/R_Travel_D’. Alternatively you can also refer https://github.com/SAP-samples/abap-platform-rap100/blob/main/exercises/ex04

Task2: Enhance determination with Joule Code Prediction Capability

Use Joule's Predictive Code Completion feature to complete your code by providing simple prompts for each step in the logic.

Here please note that we should use the Toggle option to disable / enable Joule Code Prediction Capability by pressing  button in the toolbar.

Hint: Disable the Joule Code Prediction Capability if you want to give prompts for new steps / once finished to stop Automatic Code Prediction.

Note:- The logic and examples are mentioned just for your reference and to make the purpose of the challenge easy to understand. Please feel free to use your own logic and dataset.

To know how to use Predictive Code Completion follow this tutorial

Please note that the challenge will remain open for another week for anyone who is running late. 

Before we close for this year we would like to thank everyone who participated. We hope all of you enjoyed the challenge. Let us continue to explore how SAP Joule for developers, ABAP AI capabilities can support us with our day-to-day tasks when working with ABAP code, to increase our efficiency and to lower total cost of development.

Happy Jouling!!!

entry.title: 🇮🇳 Getting started with Generative AI Hub on SAP AI Core ( Coimbatore, India)
entry.content:
We hit the limit of 25 attendees on May 20th. If you would like to be considered in case of any cancellations, please leave a comment below.

This SAP CodeJam event is on Getting Started with Generative AI Hub on SAP AI Core and Python. You do not need any background in the topic, but you should have a lot of curiosity!

In this CodeJam, you will learn how to use the Generative AI Hub on SAP AI Core to implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). This approach improves the responses of large language models (LLMs) and reduces hallucinations. You will learn how to deploy an LLM and the orchestration service on SAP AI Core, and how to query it via SAP AI Launchpad and the Python SDK. Additionally, you will gain insights into key generative AI concepts and learn how to enhance RAG responses.

Location and Date:

This is a free in-person event only (not virtual) and is planned for Wednesday, June 17th, 2026 from 10:00 - 15:30 IST in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. The language of the event and the content will be English.

Event Address:  Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited, CHIL-SEZ, Keeranatham Village, Coimbatore - 641 035, Tamil Nadu.

The instructor is SAP Developer Advocate @sheenamk

The event is kindly hosted by Bosch Coimbatore. Thank you!

Prerequisites: 

Any Chromium-based web browser, such as Vivaldi, Brave, Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome etc.

Please note that spaces are limited! We can only accommodate 25 attendees. If you want to attend, register by clicking the Yes button in the Will you be attending? section above to the right. A confirmation email will be send to all registered participants 1 week before the event.

For more information on SAP CodeJam events, head over to the SAP CodeJam group.

entry.title: 🇯🇵 Build Code-based AI Agents on SAP Business AI Platform (Tokyo, Japan)
entry.content:
REGISTRATION IS NOW CLOSED FOR THIS EVENT - We will send confirmation emails to first 40 attendees a couple of weeks before the event and we will manage a waitlist, in case some of the RSVPs are unable to make it to the event.

In this CodeJam, you will learn how to build state-of-the-art AI agents using the Generative AI Hub and Python. You will also gain the skills to create custom tools for your agents, including leveraging SAP's RPT-1 model. Finally, you will deploy your agents to SAP BTP.

In this CodeJam you will build your agents with Python and CrewAI.

The CodeJam will include the following SAP technologies:

- Generative AI Hub on SAP AI Core

- SAP RPT-1

- Grounding Service

- SAP AI Launchpad

- Business Application Studio (Python)

Exercise Content:  https://github.com/SAP-samples/codejam-code-based-agents

Prerequisites: 

  • Bring your own laptop with power adapter and have a supported Chromium-based browser
  • It can be helpful to bring a tablet or second laptop, if you have one, to have the instructions on a separate screen.

Location and Date:

This is a free in-person event and is planned for Monday, September 28, in Tokyo from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM local time. The event's language and content will be in English. 

Event Address:

SIGMAXYZ Inc, Training Center 7F Kamiyacho Prime Place, 4-1-17 Toranomon, Minato-ku, Tokyo.
  •  Special thanks to SAP Japan Community for hosting this event.
  • The instructors are SAP Developer Advocates @Shilpa_Shankar & @sheenamk 

Please note that spaces are limited! We can only accommodate 40 attendees. If you want to attend, register by clicking the Yes button in the Will you be attending? section above to the right. About 2 weeks before the event, you will receive an email to confirm your attendance and will receive further instructions.

entry.title: 🇬🇪 SAP CodeJam ABAP: SAP BTP, ABAP Environment & RAP ( Tbilisi, Georgia )
entry.content:
This SAP CodeJam event is on the topic of the ABAP Cloud, and specifically introduces attendees to ABAP Cloud and the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model. ABAP Cloud is the ABAP-based development model for S/4HANA Cloud, S/4HANA on-premise, and SAP BTP, ABAP environment.

Learn how to use proven and new technologies, such as Core Data Services (CDS) and behavior definition and implementation languages, to build SAP Fiori apps and OData services on any of the ABAP Cloud options. In this hands-on experience, developers will create their first ABAP applications using ABAP Cloud, expose and consume services via HTTP, and explore the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model.

This is an in-person event only (not virtual) and is planned for Monday 21st September 2026 in Tbilisi, Georgia from 11:00 - 17:00 Georgia Standard Time. The language and content of the event will be in English.

Location: EPAM, 10 Bidzina Kvernadze St, Tbilisi 0171, Georgia.

Google Map : https://maps.app.goo.gl/EPM7n7wqqqZ2JS8s8

The event is kindly hosted by EPAM, Georgia. Thank you! Please note that spaces are limited - we can only accommodate 25 attendees. If you wish to attend, register by clicking the Yes button in the Will you be attending? section above to the right. A few weeks before the event, we will ask you to confirm your attendance.

The instructor is Developer Advocate @Shilpa_Shankar & @sheenamk 

There are essential prerequisites that must be completed by every attendee, before arriving at the event location. They are documented here: abap-exercises-codejam/prerequisites.md at main · SAP-samples/abap-exercises-codejam (github.com).

For more information on SAP CodeJam events, to ask questions, and to chat with your fellow attendees, head over to the SAP CodeJam group.
